About This Job
We are seeking an experienced and motivated General Dentist to take on a unique dual clinical and leadership role within Aviemore Dental & Implant Clinic, combining 2–3 days of clinical practice with dedicated time to lead, influence and help shape the future direction of the team.
This is an exciting opportunity to combine hands-on patient care with a meaningful leadership role within a well-established, highly respected dental practice in the heart of the Scottish Highlands.
With two clear pathways available, you can shape your role around how you want to lead and contribute — whether that is through clinical leadership, shared ownership, or both over time.
Role Structure
•
Work 2–3 days per week clinically within the practice as an Associate Dentist
•
Dedicate approximately 4 hours per week to leadership responsibilities within the Practice Clinical Lead function
•
Combine hands-on dentistry with protected time to support team development, clinical standards, governance and practice performance
•
Help shape the future direction of a long-established practice with strong roots in the local community
•
Flexibility to shape your contribution depending on the pathway you choose and the needs of the practice
The Opportunity
At Aviemore Dental & Implant Clinic, we recognise that leadership looks different for different clinicians. That’s why we offer two distinct ways to step into this role.
Shared Ownership Model
Take a meaningful stake in the practice and play a central role in its future.
•
Become a partner through a simple, transparent shared ownership model
•
Share directly in the profitability and long-term success of the practice
•
Combine clinical leadership with commercial influence and decision-making
•
Help shape the direction of the practice, from patient care and clinical standards to performance and growth
•
Work as part of a wider group with the support, scale and infrastructure of PortmanDentex
This pathway is designed for clinicians who want to become deeply invested in the success of an established community practice and play a significant role in its continued development.
Practice Clinical Lead (PCL)
Step into a recognised clinical leadership role focused on care, standards and team development.
•
Work closely with the Practice Manager to drive performance and positive patient outcomes
•
Shape clinical standards, protocols and the patient journey
•
Support, mentor and develop the clinical team
•
Champion clinical governance, best practice and continuous improvement
•
Contribute to decision-making and the strategic direction of the practice
•
Help create a culture where clinicians can develop, collaborate and deliver consistently high-quality care
This option is ideal for clinicians who want to influence and lead without taking on an ownership stake.
About Aviemore Dental & Implant Clinic
Aviemore Dental & Implant Clinic is a long-established private dental practice that has served the local community for over 30 years. The practice has built its reputation on quality, trust and delivering first-class dentistry, with a strong focus on long-term patient care.
The practice is patient-centred and committed to providing high-quality dentistry for the whole family. Prevention is central to the practice philosophy, alongside a commitment to continual professional development and keeping clinical knowledge and skills up to date.
The clinic also has a particular strength in dental implant treatment, offering patients comprehensive implant consultations and modern treatment options to restore missing teeth and improve both oral health and quality of life.
This is an opportunity to join a practice with an established reputation while having genuine influence over its next chapter.
About You
We are looking for a clinician who is not only an excellent dentist, but someone who wants to make a wider contribution to the practice.
You will ideally be:
•
A GDC-registered dentist with strong clinical experience
•
A natural leader who communicates with clarity and builds trust
•
Committed to high-quality, patient-centred care
•
Motivated to develop and support colleagues
•
Interested in clinical governance, standards and continuous improvement
•
Commercially aware and interested in practice performance
•
Comfortable working collaboratively with the Practice Manager and wider team
•
Enthusiastic about shaping the future direction of an established practice
•
Someone who sees leadership as an opportunity to make a positive difference to patients and colleagues
Whether you are already in a leadership position or are an experienced clinician ready to take the next step, we would be keen to hear from you.
What We Offer
•
A supportive and collaborative environment where leadership is encouraged
•
The flexibility to choose the pathway that best fits how you want to contribute
•
Protected leadership time alongside your clinical work
•
Ongoing professional development and leadership support
•
The opportunity to influence how care is delivered every day
•
A clear and transparent shared ownership model for those who want it
•
The opportunity to work within an established practice with strong community relationships
•
Access to the wider support, infrastructure and clinical network of PortmanDentex
Live and Work in Aviemore
There are few places that offer the combination of professional opportunity and lifestyle that Aviemore provides.
Situated in Badenoch and Strathspey, Aviemore sits within the Cairngorms National Park, surrounded by spectacular mountains, ancient Caledonian pine forests, lochs and the River Spey. It is a vibrant Highland community and a year-round destination for outdoor enthusiasts.
For those who enjoy an active lifestyle, the area offers exceptional opportunities for walking, mountain biking, skiing, snow sports, climbing, water sports and wildlife experiences. The surrounding Cairngorms are home to some of Scotland’s most spectacular landscapes, while Rothiemurchus, Loch Morlich and the Cairngorm Mountains are all close by.
Aviemore is also a great base for exploring the wider Highlands, with nearby communities including Boat of Garten, Carrbridge, Kincraig, Kingussie, Newtonmore, Grantown-on-Spey and Nethy Bridge.
Despite its Highland setting, Aviemore is well connected by road, rail and bus, with direct rail connections serving the town and regular public transport links to other parts of the Cairngorms and beyond. Inverness is approximately 31 miles away and provides airport connections, while Perth is around 84 miles south.
For someone looking for a change of pace, a fantastic quality of life and the chance to build a meaningful leadership role within a respected dental practice, Aviemore offers something genuinely different.

Aviemore Dental & Implant Clinic is part of PortmanDentex, one of the UK and Ireland’s leading private-focused dental groups.

About This Job
Fleet Engineering Graduate Programme
Location: Grantham
Contract Type: Full-time, Permanent
Start Date: 20th September 2027
Welcome to the Sysco GB Fleet Graduate Programme!
At Sysco, food is at the centre of everything we do. As a global leader in foodservice wholesale distribution we operate with over 75,000 colleagues across 10 countries worldwide.  Driven by our purpose to connect the world to share food and care for one another, we’re proud to supply the expertise, products and partnerships that power every corner of the industry - from independent high street cafes to large‑scale corporate customers, and from hospitals and schools to pubs, restaurants and fine dining establishments across the UK.
Behind the scenes, our Engineering team plays a vital role in making all of this possible. They are responsible for the design of our sites, the engineering management of our fleet and onsite transport vehicles, the facilities management that keeps our operations running safely & efficiently, and finally the sustainably of the site operations.
This programme offers an exciting opportunity to build a career in Fleet Engineering, combining technical learning with real operational impact. You'll gain experience across fleet maintenance, engineering support, vehicle performance, compliance, and continuous improvement, developing the skills and confidence to influence decisions that enhance fleet reliability and customer service.
We're looking for enthusiastic individuals with a passion for vehicles, a willingness to learn, and the drive to continuously improve. If you're excited about the future of transport, engineering innovation, and helping keep a critical fleet operating efficiently, this programme is the perfect place to start your career.
Your journey starts here-let’s engineer something extraordinary.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The Sysco GB Graduate Programme is designed to give you a dynamic and inspiring start to your career. You’ll gain hands on experience, take part in structured learning, and receive personalised mentorship to help you transition into the workplace and develop the skills and confidence needed to grow as a future leader. Through key business rotations, you’ll work on real projects, collaborate with a variety of teams, and gain valuable exposure to senior leaders.
You can expect...
• A structured learning and development plan to build both your technical and professional capabilities
• Mentorship from experienced professionals who will support, guide, and challenge you throughout the programme
• Business placements that give you the experience and exposure to build your skills within HR
• Networking opportunities with graduates, colleagues, and industry partners to help you grow your professional network
• Continued professional development including workshops, training sessions, and access to learning resources to accelerate your growth
• Exposure to senior leaders providing valuable insights and helping you build your profile across the organisation
• Clear opportunities for career progression and continued development opportunities post programme
What You’ll Experience:
Our Fleet Engineering Graduate Programme gives you the opportunity to play a key role in keeping our fleet safe, compliant, reliable, and ready to serve our customers every day. You'll develop the technical expertise, problem-solving mindset, and operational understanding needed to help shape the future of Fleet Engineering at Sysco.
You’ll gain hands-on experience across the full fleet lifecycle, from vehicle specification and fleet planning through to engineering, maintenance, compliance, and continuous improvement. Working alongside experienced fleet engineers, compliance specialists, maintenance providers, and operational leaders, you'll build the knowledge and confidence to make a real impact on a critical part of our business.
The first six months of your programme will be spent fully immersing yourself in our Operations and Distribution business. This will involve working as part of both our warehouse and transport teams, experiencing day and night shifts, and gaining a thorough understanding of how we operate and deliver for our customers.
Following this induction period, you’ll be supporting fleet projects and initiatives across our UK network. Through key placements in Fleet Build & Planning, Fleet Engineering & Maintenance, and Compliance, you'll gain experience in:
• Fleet specification, procurement, and vehicle lifecycle planning
• Fleet engineering and maintenance strategies
• Vehicle performance, reliability, and asset optimisation
• Transport legislation, vehicle compliance, and regulatory requirements
• Supporting the introduction of new vehicle technologies and sustainability initiatives
• Working with maintenance providers, manufacturers, and operational teams
• Participation in fleet improvement and engineering projects
• Data analysis, reporting, and performance monitoring
• Development of technical procedures, standards, and documentation
• Continuous improvement initiatives that enhance fleet safety, efficiency, and customer service
You’ll also be fully supported to complete various technical training to support your journey to Chartership.   This is your chance to make an impact, learn from industry experts, and kick start your career.
Key Information:
• This programme is based from our Grantham site but will require travel across the UK to our depot and office locations. In addition, there will be graduate workshops and other key business events that may take place at sites across the UK.
• There is potential for a company car in year 2 of the programme dependent on your project sites.
• Placement rotations will be a combination of fully onsite and hybrid working models
• 39hrs a week, Monday – Friday  (some night shift working during initial induction period so that you get to experience our full operation)
What you’ll need to succeed:
• A minimum of a 2:1 or above Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in an Engineering degree field
• Passion for vehicles and interest in pursuing a career in Fleet Engineering
• Driving licence and access to transport
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment & independently
• Analytical and problem-solving abilities
• Proactive, adaptable, and eager to learn
• Initiative and a growth mindset

At EDF, Success is Personal. That means your journey is unique to you. Join as our Nuclear Engineering Industrial Placement on electrical mechanical systems with the Fuel Route Dept  and you’ll gain hands-on experience, develop key skills, and help Britain achieve net zero – all while shaping a career that’s truly yours.
"Electricity is such a vital component in everyone’s lives. It powers schools, businesses and hospitals, so I knew that if I did my placement within EDF then I would have a really large impact on society, and that made my placement a lot more fulfilling.” Priyanka, Science and Engineering Industrial Placement.

This 12-month placement offers a starting salary of £26,050 and the chance to work on site at Torness Power Station.
You’ll launch your career in Nuclear Engineering with our customised training programme. Taking on a real job at a junior level, you'll gain invaluable hands-on experience while being mentored by highly skilled professionals.
You’ll help shape equipment reliability of a particular plant area, learn engineering and safety case principles in order to do work on a Nuclear Power Plant. You’ll also gain experience in team working, problem solving, and using human performance tools, with opportunities to work on plant operations and explore other areas of interest.

During your Nuclear Engineering, you’ll gain in-depth experience within an multi-discipline team and work with electrical, mechanical, control and instrumentation engineers. Additionally, you'll have the opportunity to see how other departments within the power station function, expanding your understanding of the broader industry.

Your Work Location
You’ll be based on site at our power station situated at our Torness Power Station, Scotland.
Who You Are
To be eligible for this scheme, you need to be on track to achieve, or have already achieved, a 2:2 undergraduate or postgraduate degree in Electrical, Mechanical or Control & Instrumentation.

About This Job
Start here. Grow here.
“Are you ready to join a team of flood risk specialists and shape the future of the Water Industry?”
We’re looking for an Associate to join our growing Water team. You’ll play a senior technical role, leading teams to deliver real-time flood forecasting projects, while helping to expand our services with the Environment Agency and beyond.
Although your primary focus will be on flood forecasting, you’ll also have opportunities to work on wider hydrology and non-real-time modelling projects.
Here's what you'll do
• Produce and review Flood Forecasting Inception Stage Reports, including assessing the quality of existing models and hydrometric data.
• Develop, calibrate, and check flood forecasting models (e.g. PDM, Flood Modeller).
• Carry out non-real-time modelling and hydrological analysis using tools such as Flood Modeller, ICM, HEC-RAS, MIKE 11, and FEH hydrological methods.
• Produce and review high-quality technical reports, documenting model build and associated uncertainties.
• Lead and contribute to tenders for key clients.
• Mentor and support team members in their professional development.
• Build strong relationships with clients and colleagues across disciplines.
• Stay up to date with legislation and guidelines relevant to our services.
• Use AECOM’s project management systems to deliver high-quality outputs on time and within budget.
Become part of our dynamic Water business, which boasts around 600 experts across the UK & Ireland. Collaborate with top-tier engineers and consultants to deliver a variety of captivating projects, from small initiatives to large-scale ventures, all the way from concept to completion.
If you're passionate about innovation and turning bold ideas into reality, we want to hear from you! Why not give our AECOM Water page on LinkedIn a follow to stay updated on the impactful projects we're working on and see firsthand the difference we're making in the industry!
Come grow with us.
Become part of our dynamic Water business, which boasts around 700 experts across the UK & Ireland. Collaborate with top-tier engineers and consultants to deliver a variety of captivating projects, from small initiatives to large-scale ventures, all the way from concept to completion.
At AECOM, you’ll thrive in an inclusive and forward-thinking environment where your contributions are valued - and let's not forget about the perks! You'll enjoy a range of core and personalised benefits designed to support your future and well-being, customised to fit your lifestyle. Take advantage of career development opportunities, technical practice networks, AECOM University, volunteering days and our flexible hybrid working model to ensure a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle. We recognise that everyone’s circumstances are different, so we’re happy to discuss part-time or flexible working arrangements that suit you.
Why Join Us:
• Be part of a dynamic team that tackles challenging and impactful water projects.
• Work alongside industry-leading professionals and thought leaders.
• Engage in a collaborative and inclusive work environment.
• Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
• Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
• Enjoy the flexibility to work in a way that fits your lifestyle while supporting a healthy work–life balance.

Qualifications
Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?
Here’s what we’re looking for:
• Significant experience in flood forecasting modelling (Flood Modeller).
• Strong knowledge of Environment Agency requirements, including preparing flood forecasting models compatible with their Incident Management Forecasting Systems.
• Proven ability in applying and calibrating hydrological models in flood forecasting (e.g. Muskingum-Cunge, Probability Distribution Model).
• Excellent analytical skills, with experience in processing and analysing hydrometric data, including gauge rating reviews.
• A Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Civil Engineering or another relevant discipline.
• Strong GIS skills (QGIS, ArcGIS and/or MapInfo).
• Practical knowledge of scripting (Python, Anaconda, Ruby, or similar) would be an advantage.
You will also be self-motivated with an ability to work both autonomously where required, with a strong sense of commitment, a willingness to learn and a desire to work in a dynamic deadline driven team environment.
At AECOM, we believe in creating a better world through innovative and sustainable solutions. If you share our vision and are ready to make a difference in the water industry, we want to hear from you.

Application Support
We celebrate diversity, including neurodiversity, and believe it enriches our team. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and abilities. If you are an applicant with a disability that requires reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us at ReasonableAdjustments@aecom.com. At AECOM, we value everyone's unique contributions and perspectives.
If you meet some of the requirements above or have transferable skills you believe would benefit us, we would be delighted to hear from you!

About This Job
The GTM Lead - AI Optimization Product is responsible for driving the global go-to-market (GTM) success of IFS's Optimisation portfolio — Planning & Scheduling Optimization (PSO), Manufacturing Scheduling & Optimization (MSO), and the What-If Scenario Explorer (WISE). Acting as the commercial and proposition owner across these offerings, this role works across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to define the GTM strategy, build the proposition, and accelerate pipeline growth and strategic deal execution.
This is a cross-portfolio role rather than a single-product sales role. AI is a collection of capabilities spanning machine learning through to agentic and frontier large language models, and the Optimisation portfolio completes that stack: PSO, MSO, and WISE apply machine learning to autonomous scheduling, planning, and predictive decisioning, increasingly integrated with agentic and frontier AI approaches to extend what customers can do with them. The AI Optimisation GTM Lead is responsible for defining the strategy and narrative that connects PSO, MSO, and WISE within this broader AI stack: how optimisation, scheduling, and predictive modeling combine to help customers make better decisions, faster, with less manual effort. The role owns the offering GTM plan, faces off directly to the product teams, and carries a number for the portfolio.
Success in this role is measured through pipeline generation, proposition and GTM adoption, strategic deal influence, and overall commercial performance of the Optimisation portfolio.
Key Responsibilities
Portfolio Strategy & Proposition
•
Own and execute the global GTM strategy for the Optimisation portfolio (PSO, MSO, WISE), ensuring alignment across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partners.
•
Act as the commercial owner and cross-portfolio AI strategist for Optimisation, defining the common theme and narrative that connects PSO, MSO, and WISE as a single proposition rather than three disconnected products.
•
Face off directly to the product teams to shape roadmap priorities, packaging, and monetisation based on market and customer feedback.
•
Develop and continuously refine repeatable GTM motions that accelerate market penetration and revenue growth across the portfolio.
Sales Plays & Commercial Strategy
•
Define, launch, and optimise high-impact sales plays for PSO, MSO, and WISE — individually and as a combined optimisation proposition.
•
Build commercial motions that enable both standalone Optimisation opportunities and attach opportunities alongside IFS Cloud and adjacent AI offerings such as Nexus Black and IFS.ai.
•
Identify market opportunities, competitive positioning, and customer use cases across field service, high-tech and discrete manufacturing, and scenario planning.
•
Continuously evaluate sales performance and refine GTM approaches based on market feedback and commercial outcomes.
Strategic Deal Leadership
•
Personally support and influence the company's largest global Optimisation opportunities, including the top strategic standalone deals.
•
Partner with regional sales leaders throughout complex sales cycles to improve deal quality, competitive positioning, and win rates.
•
Facilitate executive engagement and cross-functional collaboration for strategic pursuits.
•
Capture and share best practices from major opportunities to improve repeatability across the organisation.
Pipeline Growth & Revenue Enablement
•
Drive a sustainable pipeline strategy targeting a minimum four-times pipeline coverage against revenue objectives for the Optimisation portfolio.
•
Partner with Marketing to develop and execute demand generation campaigns that create qualified pipeline for PSO, MSO, and WISE.
•
Monitor pipeline health, campaign effectiveness, and conversion metrics, recommending corrective actions where required.
•
Identify opportunities to improve pipeline quality, sales velocity, and forecast accuracy.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
•
Work closely with Product Management across PSO, MSO, and WISE to ensure market feedback influences product direction and roadmap priorities.
•
Partner with Marketing to create compelling messaging, customer stories, thought leadership, and campaign content that articulate the Optimisation portfolio's AI narrative.
•
Collaborate with Sales Enablement to develop training, playbooks, and sales resources that increase field effectiveness.
•
Support Partner teams with GTM strategies that expand market reach through the ecosystem.
Performance Management & Continuous Improvement
•
Define and monitor key commercial performance metrics across pipeline generation, win rates, deal progression, and GTM effectiveness for the portfolio.
•
Provide regular updates and recommendations to senior leadership, including the AI Business Unit, on market performance, strategic opportunities, and execution priorities.
•
Foster a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve execution, and increase commercial impact.
Success Measures
Success in this role will be demonstrated through:

Delivery of global GTM campaigns that generate measurable pipeline growth across PSO, MSO, and WISE.

Achievement of at least a 4x pipeline multiple against commercial targets.

Growth in standalone Optimisation revenue alongside increased IFS Cloud attachment rates.

Establishment of a single, coherent Optimisation portfolio narrative and proposition across PSO, MSO, and WISE.

Imagine being the person who turns mundane weekends into delightful experiences, filled with warmth, understanding, and a helping hand that attends to not just physical needs but reaches out to nourish the soul with companionship and joy. About This Job
Lead line maintenance shift execution to protect aircraft airworthiness, dispatch reliability, and safe service continuity across assigned operations. The role provides certification control, resource direction, and real-time coordination so defects are resolved within approved maintenance standards, disruption is contained, and maintenance activity remains compliant with company, regulatory, and safety requirements.
Accountabilities
• Organize and direct line maintenance shift delivery against the daily operating plan, allocating certified engineers and technicians to priority aircraft, balancing defect recovery with turnaround demand, and re-sequencing work when disruptions, manpower gaps, or operational changes emerge to protect dispatch reliability and aircraft availability across the operating day
• Authorize maintenance release actions within current privileges, verifying that work is completed against approved data, aircraft effectivity, and revision control before return to service, and escalating any limitation, anomaly, or non-conformance that could affect airworthiness or service continuity
• Implement safety, security, and quality controls across the shift, including risk assessment for significant changes, SMS requirements, incident reporting, and the readiness of tooling, GSE, and technical references so maintenance activity remains safe, controlled, and audit ready at all times
• Manage workforce readiness and discipline by maintaining staffing coverage, briefing incoming teams, monitoring duty fitness, and identifying development needs, training opportunities, and certification gaps so the shift retains the skills and authorizations required for planned aircraft types and operational recovery through handover and the following duty period
• Coordinate directly with MCC, Maintenance Planning, Operations Control, and line stations to communicate incoming defects, agree action priorities, provide accurate technical feedback, and close unresolved items, ensuring the right resources and decisions are in place before aircraft return to service and during recovery
• Monitor maintenance execution, paperwork, and record quality across the shift, ensuring work packs, technical records, and certification entries are completed accurately and on time, trends are reviewed, and recurring defects or process deviations are escalated with practical recommendations to improve reliability, reduce repeat intervention, and strengthen future planning
• Lead line maintenance during operational disruption or the Senior Manager's absence, making timely local decisions within delegated authority, maintaining continuity of service, and escalating matters that exceed shift control so the department continues to meet safety, availability, and customer expectations throughout the duty period.
People Management Responsibilities:
• Lead and develop the team to ensure effective delivery of functional objectives, providing clear direction, guidance, and development support.
• Guide day-to-day team leadership through coaching, support, and clear communication of expectations.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in aeronautical, mechanical, electrical, or electronic engineering preferred, or equivalent technical qualification
• Experience:
• 15+ years in aircraft maintenance within airline or MRO environments
•  5+ years leading line maintenance, duty management, or shift coordination in a 24/7 operational environment
• Experience managing certification control, defect recovery, and cross-functional recovery decisions across multiple aircraft types
• Fluent in English

The Director, Private Credit & Debt Solutions is responsible for driving the execution of the global debt & credit sales strategy for IQ-EQ Group’s clients and ensures this drives the company's key objective of profitable organic growth.
The role will be accountable for achieving an annually agreed organic growth target that leads to the overall revenue growth of the Debt & Credit clients of the Group by setting out and executing a growth strategy addressing new client acquisition and commercial collaboration between the IQ-EQ offices and other segment leads.
The role also includes rolling out a consistent Go-to-Market strategy globally for the Debt & Credit market and drive commercial collaboration results to an agreed target level.  The role also focuses on ensuring consistent pricing in line with the agreed pricing model and working with clients and teams to improve client profitability where required.
What You'll Do:
• You'll drive the global rollout and execution of our Debt & Credit Sales Strategy, establishing frameworks that stimulate commercial collaboration across all IQ-EQ offices and identify new business opportunities.
• You'll develop and maintain our consultative value proposition for debt & credit clients, conducting market research and competitor analysis to differentiate our offering and secure Tier 1 pitches with improved RFP conversion rates.
• You'll build and nurture strategic relationships with key decision-makers at Tier 1 debt & credit clients, leading stakeholder review meetings and developing comprehensive Client Plans to maximise revenue growth through up-sell and cross-selling opportunities.
• You'll collaborate with the Global Head of DCM&C to expand our service offering through new partnerships, identify loan administration opportunities, and establish best practice solutions with technology enhancements that expedite delivery and improve win rates.
• You'll manage pricing policies across the Group, monitor long-term profitability of key client relationships, and work with local teams to optimise commercial terms and increase profitability on multi-jurisdictional deals.
• You'll ensure accurate pipeline management and conversion of key debt & credit opportunities by working closely with local CCOs and heads of sales, whilst identifying and recruiting top debt & credit talent across the market.
• You'll champion thought leadership and market awareness through coordinated marketing initiatives, brand development, LinkedIn campaigns, and business development planning that positions IQ-EQ as a leading debt & credit solutions provider.
What we offer
• Comprehensive remuneration: Motivating financial packages based upon market rates for your role and is proportionate to your qualifications, level of experiences and skills profile.
• Wellbeing: Additional social benefits such as private health and dental cover, life assurance, discounted gym membership, eye test and corporate GP.
• Annual leave: All our employees are entitled to 25 days paid leave, plus all UK public holidays. Enhanced maternity and paternity, including shared parental leave and adoption leave.
• Flexible working: We recognize the value of working flexibly and is keen to ensure all employees enjoy an excellent work-life blend. As such, we are open to conversations with employees related to setting up flexible working arrangements.
• Support and development: We will ensure you have the right training, tools and development plan to grow and improve your skills every day.

Qualifications
About You:
• You hold a degree in Accounting, Law, Business Management or a related field, complemented by relevant professional qualifications.
• You bring 15+ years of specialist experience in the Debt & Credit sector, with a significant portion at senior leadership level, including proven commercial client-facing expertise.
• You possess extensive knowledge of alternative investment funds, debt & credit technologies, regulatory environments, debt origination, loan administration and securitisation structures.
• You have demonstrated accomplishments in Sales and Business Development, with experience in Big4 or asset management environments being advantageous.
• You combine strategic commercial acumen with the ability to build and nurture relationships with Tier 1 clients whilst driving profitable growth across multi-jurisdictional debt & credit solutions.

Additional Information
OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT
As a forward-looking business, sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining meaningful, long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.
There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. About This Job
We're looking for an Implementation Manager to join our fast-growing Finance & Treasury Product team in London or Tallinn. This is a unique opportunity to have an impact on Wise's mission by making sure our customers' money stays safe as we launch new products and expand into new markets.
Your mission
Wise customers trust us to keep their money safe. Safeguarding is how we make sure that every penny we hold for customers is protected, in every country we operate in.
Today we run safeguarding across 11 legal entities and client asset protection (CASS) across 6. That means more than 500 bank accounts in scope, 5+ external audits a year, regular internal audit and regulator reviews, and several new legal entities launching every year.
As Wise grows, so does our Safeguarding team. Our global team builds and runs the automated controls and tools that every entity relies on, while regional teams own what happens locally. As the Implementation Manager, you'll connect the two. You'll make sure new products and entities are onboarded into our controls properly, and that incidents are handled quickly and transparently.
You'll work closely with the Safeguarding Product Manager, Safeguarding Engineering and Analytics, Treasury and Regulatory Product Compliance, Finance, Payment and Treasury Operations, and regional controllers around the world.
How you'll contribute to our mission
New product reviews, onboarding and approval
- Run the safeguarding review and approval process for new products and product changes, making sure every step is followed and nothing launches without the right controls in place.
- Follow up with product teams, Treasury Regulatory Product Compliance and Finance to keep projects moving.
- Keep a clear, up-to-date tracker of projects that need safeguarding support, and report on their status.
New entity launches
- Support new legal entities as they launch, working out how they'll be onboarded into our global systems and controls.
- Define how controls need to be set up locally for each entity, for example safeguarding timings.
- Work with Regional Finance and Compliance so that local controllers are ready to take ownership from day one.
Execution and implementation
- Plan and lead the work to integrate new Wise products into our safeguarding systems, together with product managers, engineers, data analysts and operations specialists.
- Own large, complex integrations from start to finish, and support the team with clear documentation: requirements, project plans, resourcing, testing and delivery.
Support
- Keep documentation of product flows and safeguarding calculations up to date.
- Get hands-on when things go wrong: help product and engineering teams understand the impact of an incident, drive it to resolution, and improve controls so it doesn't happen again.

Qualifications
A bit about you
- You know regulated finance. You have experience in implementation, controls, regulatory operations or treasury operations in financial services or fintech, and you're used to working alongside Compliance to launch things the right way.
- You understand how customer money is protected. You know safeguarding, client money/CASS or a similar framework for protecting customer funds. If you know one regime well and are keen to learn others, that works too.
- You enjoy getting deep into the processing logic. You're comfortable with reconciliations, ledgers and financial data. You like to understand in depth how money flows through a product and what it depends on, and you can explain what a reconciliation break means and why it matters.
- You create clarity. You bring people together behind a common goal, balance different points of view and bring structure to complex problems. You write clearly, and you can explain complex concepts in simple terms to engineers, compliance specialists, finance teams and senior stakeholders without losing the nuance.
- You get it done. You keep many workstreams moving across teams and time zones without losing track of the details. You hold others to account without being their line manager, and you follow things through to the end.
- You stay calm when things go wrong. You make sound calls during incidents, and you know when to escalate.
Some extra skills that are great (but not essential)
- Experience supporting external or internal audits, or regulator inspections.
- Experience with control frameworks, obligation-to-control mapping or risk tools.
- Working knowledge of SQL or data tools (e.g. Looker, Snowflake) for investigating issues yourself.
- Experience launching a new regulated entity or a new market.
- Familiarity with safeguarding rules in more than one region (UK, EU, APAC, North America).

Additional Information
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders  — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

About This Job
Role summary
We are looking for an ambitious, commercially minded Investment Manager to originate, structure and execute commercial and development debt opportunities across the UK. This is a senior, front-line role with direct accountability for generating new business, converting opportunities and delivering agreed lending targets.
The successful candidate will bring a strong network of brokers, borrowers, advisers and market contacts, together with a credible track record in UK real estate finance. They will be expected to independently assess opportunities, identify the key risks, structure appropriate lending solutions and take viable transactions from initial enquiry through Credit Committee and completion.
The role is highly client-facing and relationship driven, but requires a strong level of transaction ownership. Alongside individual origination. The Investment Manager will contribute to market strategy, support the development of junior colleagues and help ensure the investment team maintains a high-quality, well-converting pipeline.
What is in it for you
• A senior front-line investment role with autonomy, established funding lines and direct responsibility for originating and executing transactions.
• The opportunity to help grow a commercial and development debt strategy within an established real estate debt platform.
• Direct exposure to borrowers, brokers, advisers, Credit Committee and senior decision makers.
• Competitive base salary with performance-related bonus linked to individual origination and wider team results.
• Access to the wider Octopus benefits package, including pension, flexible working, wellness support, family leave policies, private medical insurance and other employee benefits.
What you will be doing
Origination, sales and relationship management
• Achieve and exceed agreed lending, origination and deployment targets across commercial and development debt.
• Independently source and originate new lending opportunities through an established network of brokers, borrowers, advisers and other market contacts.
• Act as a senior focal point for key relationships within the target market, building trusted long-term relationships and generating repeat business.
• Develop and maintain a high-quality introducer panel, with a disciplined rhythm of meetings, follow-ups and pipeline reviews.
• Spend significant time in the market meeting brokers, borrowers and professionals, and represent Octopus at relevant industry events, conferences and market meetings.
• Take ownership of progressing new enquiries and converting viable opportunities into completed transactions.
Market coverage and pipeline development
• Source new lending opportunities across commercial real estate, development finance and living sectors, including residential-for-sale, PBSA, co-living, build-to-rent, retirement living, care and other operational residential sectors where appropriate.
• Monitor competitor activity, pricing, market liquidity, borrower requirements and broker feedback to identify areas where Octopus can win attractive, risk-adjusted business.
• Share market intelligence internally and contribute to the development of origination strategy, product positioning and credit appetite.
• Maintain clear and accurate pipeline information, with ownership of expected timings, conversion risk, borrower feedback and forecast completions.
• Work closely with the Head of Investment and wider team to prioritise opportunities and allocate resource to the strongest prospects.
Deal assessment and execution
• Take the lead in assessing new opportunities, including borrower quality, asset type, location, business plan, exit strategy, leverage, planning status, pricing and overall fit with lending appetite.
• Structure transactions and negotiate commercial terms with borrowers and advisers, including term sheets and key transaction parameters.
• Own transactions from initial enquiry through due diligence, Credit Committee approval, documentation and completion.
• Prepare and present high-quality investment papers, deal summaries and recommendations for Credit Committee.
• Work closely with Credit, Legal, Operations, Asset Management and other internal stakeholders to resolve issues and deliver transactions efficiently.
• Challenge assumptions and information constructively, identify downside risks early and propose appropriate mitigants or alternative structures.
• Remain close to transactions after completion, maintaining borrower relationships and identifying refinancing, follow-on lending and repeat-borrower opportunities.
Team contribution and leadership
• Mentor and support junior members of the investment team, providing guidance on opportunity assessment, transaction execution and market engagement.
• Support the Head of Investment in improving origination processes, pipeline discipline, team efficiency and conversion.
• Contribute positively to a collaborative, high-performance culture across the wider real estate debt platform.

Qualifications
Experience and technical knowledge
• 3+ years of relevant experience in UK real estate debt, lending, finance or an equivalent transactional role, ideally gained with a lender, debt fund, bank, broker, alternative lender or real estate finance platform.
• A demonstrable track record of originating and executing real estate debt transactions.
• A strong and active network across brokers, borrowers, advisers and other market participants, with the ability to generate new opportunities immediately.
• Strong understanding of commercial real estate lending, development finance and the living sectors, including the key risks that influence lender appetite and transaction structure.
• Ability to assess opportunities quickly, form a clear commercial view and identify appropriate lending structures and risk mitigants.
• Experience negotiating terms and managing transactions through due diligence, Credit Committee and legal documentation to completion.
• Good financial analysis skills, with familiarity with financial models, development appraisals, cash flows, valuations and credit papers.
Personal qualities
• Entrepreneurial, proactive and results-oriented, with a strong focus on origination, conversion and delivery.
• Commercially minded and able to balance the needs of borrowers with appropriate risk-adjusted lending decisions.
• Confident and credible communicator with strong influencing and negotiation skills.
• Highly organised and disciplined, with the judgement to prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment.
• Committed to delivering an excellent service to brokers, borrowers and internal stakeholders.
• Straightforward, helpful and bold in approach, with good judgement and a collaborative mindset.
Qualifications
• Degree educated or equivalent professional experience is preferred.
• RICS, CFA, CAIA or other relevant professional qualification would be an advantage, but is not a requirement for this role.

About IFS Copperleaf
IFS Copperleaf builds decision analytics and capital planning software for the organisations that run critical infrastructure: electric, gas and water utilities, transportation and rail, oil and gas, mining, and the public sector. Our software helps asset-intensive companies decide where and when to invest, balancing cost, risk, performance and sustainability, and it is used today to manage more than $2.9 trillion of assets worldwide.
These are high-stakes, evidence-led sales. Our buyers, CFOs, VPs of Asset Management, chief engineers and capital planning leaders, answer to regulators, boards and rate cases. Winning new logos and growing ARR depends on a sales engine that runs on clean data, sharp forecasting and a deal process that makes it easy for our customers to buy.
The Role
We are hiring a Head of Revenue Operations to be the operational backbone of the Copperleaf go-to-market team. Reporting to the COO, you will own forecasting, pipeline management, the deal desk, CRM, sales analytics, territory planning, and sales compensation. You will turn a complex, enterprise sales motion into a predictable one.
This is a hands-on role for someone who can move between the boardroom and the spreadsheet. One day you are presenting the quarterly forecast and its risks to leadership; the next you are rebuilding a stage definition in Salesforce because the data is not telling us the truth. Help us sign more new logos and grow ARR, by making the sales team faster, sharper and easier to buy from.
What You Will Own
• Forecasting, pipeline and demand generation. Run the forecast and demand generation cadence end to end.
• Deal desk and deal support. Own the contracting workflow and deal review for complex, multi-year enterprise deals. Make it easy to buy.
• CRM and systems. Own Salesforce and the wider sales tech stack as the single source of truth. Set data standards and make sure the tooling serves the seller rather than the other way round.
• Sales analytics and reporting. Build reporting: pipeline bridges, conversion by stage, win/loss patterns, ARR movement, quota attainment and productivity.
• AI in the go-to-market motion. Put AI to work across RevOps: forecasting and scoring, deal and win/loss analysis, and automating the manual work. Set the standards for how the GTM team uses AI well, and lead by example.
• Planning and territory. Support annual planning: quota setting, territory and account coverage, capacity modelling and headcount planning, working closely with sales leadership and finance.
• Sales compensation. Own the sales compensation plan, including quota letters, commission structures, crediting rules and payout administration, ensuring the plan is clear, enforceable and aligned to business priorities.

Qualifications
• Substantial experience in sales operations, revenue operations or a closely related function within enterprise B2B software or SaaS, including time leading or effectively running the function.
• A strong grasp of complex, long-cycle enterprise deals with seven figure ACVs, multiple stakeholders, and procurement and legal scrutiny.
• Deep Salesforce fluency and comfort across the sales tech stack: you can design the process, not just administer it.
• Strong practical fluency with AI: you use it daily in your own work and stay at the forefront of innovation in the AI and RevOps space.
• Genuine analytical horsepower.
• A track record of improving forecast accuracy, conversion or sales productivity in a measurable way.
• Excellent communication.
Why This Role Matters
Copperleaf sells a product that helps the world’s infrastructure operators make better decisions with scarce capital. We making it easier to for our customers to buy this software.
Location and How We Work
This is a London-based role (Staines) with a hybrid pattern, combining time in our UK office with remote work. Some travel should be expected for team, customer and company events.
IFS is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive team.

Additional Information
We believe that coming together as a community, in person, is important for innovation, connection and fostering a sense of belonging. Our roles have the right balance of remote and in-office working to enable flexibility for managing your life along with ensuring a real connection with your colleagues and the broader IFS community.

About This Job
About the role
We’re looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join our Customer Support team in London, working as part of a team based across London and Budapest.
You’ll help us understand how well our customer support experience is working, identify the biggest opportunities for improvement, and shape the path towards greater automation.
This is an analytical Data Science role with a strong product focus. You’ll use customer, conversational and operational data to measure service quality, diagnose issues, propose solutions and evaluate whether they improve outcomes. A key part of the role is simplifying complex customer journeys and operational systems into clear, tractable problems the team can act on.
You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Operations and Engineering to build a shared understanding of how the system works and turn insight into action.no
What you’ll do
Measure and diagnose
•
Build a clear, data-driven understanding of customer support quality across human and automated channels.
•
Design metrics that reflect meaningful customer outcomes, including resolution quality, customer effort, process adherence, consistency, fairness, durability of resolution and cost effectiveness.
•
Identify the root causes of issues by combining machine learning, statistical methods and domain expertise from colleagues to understand what genuinely drives customer outcomes.
Identify and test solutions
•
Turn analytical insight into concrete proposals to improve the customer experience, including product changes, process improvements, automation and better human support.
•
Quantify the potential impact and value of opportunities to help the team prioritise where to invest.
•
Design and analyse experiments to determine whether proposed changes genuinely improve customer and business outcomes.
•
Use statistical modelling and causal inference where controlled experiments are not practical.
Shape the automation strategy
•
Determine the right intervention for different customer problems — whether they should be automated, augmented by AI, handled by people or prevented altogether.
•
Test and evaluate interventions to understand their impact on customer outcomes, operational effectiveness and cost.
•
Shape the long-term automation capability roadmap, identifying what we should build next to maximise the value delivered over time.
What we’re looking for
Essential
•
An ability to simplify complex systems and ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, useful abstractions and tractable analytical questions.
•
Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to get to a useful answer quickly, refine it iteratively, and know when the evidence is sufficient to support a decision.
•
Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience working with large, complex and imperfect datasets.
•
Strong grounding in statistical analysis (e.g., classical ANOVA, non-parametric uncertainty quantification, Bayesian estimation) and causal inference, with experience designing both controlled experiments and observational studies.
•
Experience applying machine learning, statistical modelling, NLP and LLM-based techniques to analyse customer behaviour and conversational data, diagnose root causes and identify the drivers of outcomes.
•
Experience designing measurement frameworks for complex customer journeys and evaluating the impact of interventions.
•
Strong product and business judgement, with a track record of using Data Science to influence important business decisions and drive measurable impact.
Preferred
•
Experience working on customer-facing products, ideally in customer support, customer operations or another high-volume service environment.
•
Experience evaluating the impact of automation or AI-powered customer experiences.
•
Experience applying predictive or behavioural modelling to support product or operational decision-making.
•
Experience working with sensitive customer data in environments with strong security, privacy or compliance requirements.
•
Experience combining quantitative analysis with qualitative or expert insight to solve complex problems.
•
Familiarity with modern analytics and machine learning tooling in a cloud environment such as AWS.
What success looks like
Success in this role means making a complex customer support system understandable enough that the team can make better decisions about it.
You’ll create clear ways of thinking about customer support quality, identify the biggest opportunities to improve outcomes, and turn those insights into concrete interventions that can be tested and measured.
Over time, you’ll help us make better decisions about where to automate, where to invest in human support, and which new capabilities to build — creating a support model that delivers more value to customers while becoming increasingly effective and scalable.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders  — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

About This Job
Petroleum Operator
Full-time,
Our Petroleum Operators are responsible for the deployment and management of military fuel sites which provide vital petroleum services to the army and defence.
Military tanks, helicopters, sea vessels - every vehicle in the Army needs fuel. As a Petroleum Operator, you will work in a Fuel Squadron and make sure our troops get the petrol, diesel and oil they need. Your training will teach you everything you need to know and later on you can gain further qualifications, progress up through the ranks and build skills you can use in industry.
There are opportunities to conduct work experience packages with industry companies to gain an understanding of working with industry fuel systems and equipment.
Find where you belong.
WORLD-CLASS TRAINING
Step 1
You'll start with your initial military training which will teach you how to be a soldier - this will cover everything from fieldcraft to handling a rifle. If you join as a Junior Soldier (under 17 years 5 months), you’ll do a 23-week basic military training course at Harrogate. If you join as a Regular Soldier (over 17 years 1 month), you’ll do the regular 14-week adult basic training.
Step 2
Next, you will undertake your 15-week Combat Logistician course at the Defence School of Transport in Leconfield. During this, you will earn your Category C+E Driving Licence and study general service driver modules. This training also gives you the opportunity to gain a broader knowledge on the Royal Logistic Corps functions and roles.
Step 3
Then you attend a 7-week course at Worthy Down Camp in Winchester to complete the Petroleum Bulk Fuel Installation Operator qualification. You are taught how to store and handle fuels, identify hazards and deal with fires and environmental issues. You start by working with a supervisor to gain experience, once you’re more skilled, you’ll have more responsibility and will learn how to test and blend fuels.
GAIN QUALIFICATIONS
• Level 2 LGV Driver Apprenticeship
• Level 3 Apprenticeship Petroleum Operations
• Level 2 Certificate Logistics & Transport
• Level 3 Certificate Logistics, Transport Oil and Gas
• National Examination Board in Occupational Safety and Health (NEBOSH)
• Transferable credits towards some Degree Programmes with appointed Universities
• Level 3/4 Diploma in Team Management
SHOW PEOPLE WHAT YOU’RE CAPABLE OF
We'll be with you every step of the way as you move up the ranks. From the moment you begin your training you'll get all the support and encouragement you need to make a success of your career. Work hard and you'll soon get promoted, which means more responsibility and extra pay.
Become a Petroleum Operator and you’ll:
-           Earn a starting salary of around £16,844 during Basic Training which will rise to £21,425 after completing 26 weeks’ training or after completing your Initial Trade Training, if less than 26 weeks
-           Receive subsidised accommodation and facilities, increasing your disposable income
-           Receive free medical and dental health cover
-           Have the continuous access promotional opportunity and to continually progress your career
-           Be sponsored to earn valuable civilian-recognised qualifications
-           Take part in Adventurous Training and be able to play your favourite sports.
BELONG TO SOMETHING THAT MATTERS.
You should be:
• Regular Army age: 16.6 – 35.6 years
Fitness requirements:
• Mid-Thigh Pull 50kg
• Medicine Ball Throw 2.7m
• Beep test 6.6
Our next deadline for application is 31st March, with further opportunities ongoing throughout the year.
FIND WHERE YOU BELONG.

Process Improvement
• Collaborate with stakeholders to elicit, document, and validate how a business or business area works, considering the people, organisation, processes, information, data and technology and document the business requirements ensuring they are clear, complete and aligned with business objectives.

Agile working

Continuous Improvement

Business Architecture and Operating Models

About This Job
Fusion energy offers the potential for significant quantities of low-carbon, inherently safe, abundantly fuelled baseload energy, supporting sustainable climate action and energy independence.  While the technical challenge remains high, confidence is increasing, and the rewards of realising fusion are almost incalculable.  Anticipated to come online for commercial purposes in the middle of this century, fusion offers a viable means to sustainable net zero in the UK and globally, as well as to increased energy security.  The UK is currently a world leader in fusion research and development and in the drive to realise commercially viable energy from fusion, a sector with an estimated value of £tns per year.
STEP (Spherical Tokamak for Energy Production) is the UK’s flagship national programme to deliver a prototype fusion energy plant, targeting 2040, and a path to the commercial viability of fusion.  STEP is deliberately bold and ambitious and seeks people who want to be part of a world-changing endeavour and who have credible and relevant experience in delivery.
STEP is led by a new company, UK Fusion Energy Ltd. (UKFE) which was established for this purpose and is wholly owned by the UK Atomic Energy Authority (UKAEA).
The magnets confining the plasma form the heart of the tokamak device. They are one of the biggest engineering challenges and their design is intimately linked with the plasma performance, overall plant size and maintenance strategy. STEP plans to exploit jointed REBCO magnets to provide the confining field required while allowing access to maintain the machine. This will require some of the biggest HTS magnets yet.
While the STEP programme targets 2040 for the operation of the STEP prototype power plant at the West Burton site, during 2025-2029 (the presently funded “tranche 2a”) the magnet team must mature the design and burn down the biggest technical risks through a step-by-step approach to technology demonstration including model coils. UKIFS must act as overall integrator and design authority while working to develop the supply chain for the fusion power plants of the future – including magnets.
Reporting to the Head of Tokamak Machine, the Magnets Engineering Manager will lead an integrated team including both UKFE / UKAEA staff and the efforts of various specialist external organisations in order to deliver both the necessary design and the necessary confidence in it. The role will develop as the programme approaches construction and external contracts are placed.
The successful candidate will champion cross-functional working with a focus on the best outcomes for the overall programme. They will thrive in a continually changing environment as both the STEP tokamak and the organisation needed to deliver it evolve at pace.
Accountability 1:  Act as Technical Authority for STEP magnets
• As delegated by the STEP Design Authority, the Magnets Engineering Manager shall be responsible for overall adequacy of magnet design and development: performance, integrity and technical delivery
Accountability 2:  Drive forward magnet design work (including remountable joints) in harmony with the overall plant design
• Prioritise design efforts to allow convergence of overall plant design
• Guide team to achieve the target design definition levels and confidence levels required by the programme
• Manage interfaces with wider STEP power plant systems
• Ensure Intellectual Property generated by the programme is managed in accordance with UKIFS policy
Accountability 3:  Effectively prioritise technical risks and deliver mitigating actions (including the related technology demonstration programme)
• Drive technology demonstration to eliminate major obstacles and increase confidence in the fulfilment of magnet requirements
• Continually review priorities and deploy resources accordingly
Accountability 4:  Interact with other technical and functional areas (e.g. plasma, power & cooling, commercial, prototype & test and project management) and external organisations
• Champion cross-functional working
• Make informed decisions and solve problems effectively, considering diverse perspectives and organizational goals
• Pursue best-for-programme solutions and lead cross-functional teams to implement them
• Work with Project Managers to manage budget and milestones

jobs.smartrecruiters.com/reachplc/744000.description_excerpt:
About This Job
From the state of roads, to local schools, to new recycling services, every one of us is affected by the decisions that councils make. You will be part of a team of 165 reporters working throughout the UK to hold local authorities to account through a BBC-supported service.
Your work will mean that everyone in and around Exeter, Teignbridge and Torbay will get to hear about what their councils are doing in their name.
If you’re a politically-minded reporter, ready to hold power to account in the South West, then this is the position for you!
We’re looking for fresh ideas and new perspectives from people from a wide range of backgrounds, and we want you to tell us the stories you believe are important from our many communities so we can continue to diversify our content.
This is a home based role, with regular travel to attend council meetings in person across all three councils. We are therefore looking for candidates based in and around Exeter, Teignbridge and Torbay.
What will the role involve?
•
A day in the life of a Local Democracy Reporter looks like this
•
You’ll be covering the key business of Exeter City Council, Teignbridge District Council and Torbay Council, as well as the political and social issues affecting their communities
•
Making sure you cover the council meetings and key decisions in a timely manner
•
You will build contacts, understand and explore the key issues, write features and break exclusives with your work having the potential to also be shown on the BBC Homepage and used by other local media partners

Qualifications
Who are we looking for?
•
You are an NCTJ or NQJ qualified journalist, ideally with 100wpm shorthand skills (or be currently working towards this), with an understanding and interest in the issues of your local community
•
Previous experience reporting on local government/councils is highly desirable
•
You have the ability to pull the stories out of the local council meetings that our readers want to know about
•
A good knowledge of social media and how you can use it to drive audience and engagement from the people in your area is an advantage
•
You’re interested in local councils and government, keen to hold politicians to account and ensure the local communities are heard
•
You are an expert on all things South West and have a solid understanding of the patch you will be covering
•
In order to travel regularly to the various councils this role covers, you ideally have access to your own vehicle

Additional Information
How we'll look after you
We take good care of our people - and that means more than just a pay packet. Whatever your role, you'll get a range of benefits, including:
• 25 days' holiday (plus bank holidays), as well as an extra day after you've been with us for three, five and 10 years. We also have a scheme to help you buy extra holiday if you want to.
• An extra day's paid leave each year to volunteer for a cause close to your community or your heart.
• Big moment day - an extra day’s paid leave for a moment that matters to you - like getting married, moving house or welcoming a new addition to the family (human or furry!)
• Help saving for your retirement - we'll match your company pension contributions up to 6% and you can contribute through salary sacrifice.
• Supportive and progressive people policies - we’re proud to have a range of policies to support people in their lives in and outside work, including enhanced family leave and policies to promote flexibility, inclusion and progression. We believe you shouldn’t have to wait to join us to know what to expect from us, which is why we share this overview of the policies we have in place to support families and carers. If there's something you want to understand more about, just ask - it won’t make a difference to your application.
• A healthcare cash plan - giving you money back for a range of medical expenses and fast access to doctor's appointments.
• Car lease scheme - you can buy a brand new electric or hybrid car through our leasing partner, and pay for it through salary sacrifice.
• Wellbeing support - including a 24/7 assistance programme for you and your family.
• Access to lots of discounts - including 15% off with Reach's very own online marketplace, Yimbly, where you can buy everything from homewares to beauty products.
• Interest-free loans - including for season tickets and technology.
If you’re excited about this role but don’t tick every single box, please don’t let that stop you from applying.
We know that everyone has their own story to tell, and we value potential, passion and the perspectives that different backgrounds bring to our work.
Diverse perspectives strengthen our teams and help us better serve our audiences, which is why we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and supported. As an equal opportunities employer, we encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.
We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair and welcoming to all, without discrimination on the basis of age, disability, gender identity, ethnicity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

About This Job
Lawyer
Nationwide & overseas
Full-time
£42,009+ with regular pay rises
No timesheets, no targets, no billing and plenty of adventure!
Army Legal Services is a specialist branch that delivers military legal support and we're interviewing soon. You will be working to the same high standards as any civilian lawyer but will be offered opportunities and challenges that few regular practices could match.
From prosecuting at a court martial to advising senior commanders on the rules of engagement in operational theatres that could be anywhere around the world, we’ll stretch your mind and test your mettle with new and varied legal challenges over a range of specialisms.  You’ll also have a crucial role in training our officers and soldiers from across the Army on the Law of Armed Conflict, military law, discipline and administrative action.
GAIN QUALIFICATIONS, LEARN NEW SKILLS
As a qualified Solicitor, Barrister or Advocate (Scotland), you have the skills and knowledge your Army needs.  We will give you the chance to take those skills further, both in practice and in giving you the opportunity to work towards your Higher Rights of Audience and other post-graduate qualifications.  From the moment you join us as a Captain, you’ll be set on a clear path for promotion and progression, receiving the support that you need to rise through the ranks and unleash your potential.  You will be trained in multiple areas of law (including the Law of Armed Conflict, International Human Rights Law, Military Law, Criminal Law and Employment Law) by some of the world’s leading academics and practitioners and asked to advise commanders on their rights and obligations, often in austere environments and highly pressured scenarios.
It doesn’t stop there.  Whatever your background when you arrive, you'll all go on to have one thing in common: you will receive the best leadership and management training in the world at the Royal Military Academy Sandhurst where you will learn what it means to be an officer in the British Army.
Sport is a big part of Army life. We know that playing sport regularly improves not only your physical fitness, but also your team work and brings a sense of camaraderie - all of which are so important to being a great soldier. You'll be encouraged to try new sports as well as developing your existing skills. You'll also get to take part in the Army's exciting programme of Adventurous Training, which is aimed at building not only your physical skills, but also leadership and team working abilities through activities like mountaineering, parachuting, skiing and diving.
BE REWARDED
Become an Army Legal Services Officer and you’ll:
v  Earn a starting salary upwards of £42,009
v  Enjoy a minimum of 38 days paid annual leave
v  Benefit from a fantastic non-contributory pension
v  Receive subsidised accommodation, facilities and travel, considerably increasing your disposable income
v  Receive outstanding and free medical and dental care
v  Take part in Adventurous Training and be able to play your favourite sports
v  Have access to free sports and gym facilities

Job Description:
At Leonardo, we have a fantastic new opportunity for an Aerospace Product Support Engineering Degree Apprentice (Level 6).
Our Aerospace Engineering Degree Apprenticeship programme caters for those who are interested in the practical and theoretical aspects of supporting a fleet of helicopters, helping to maintain airworthy and available aircraft, along with performance analysis of our products.
Over the five and a half year programme you will be trained to become a Product Support Engineer, and become an integral part of the Customer Support organisation, with the ultimate aim of moving you into a final placement area based on business requirements and the skills displayed during the apprenticeship.
During the Degree Apprenticeship, you will:
Start with an Induction into Leonardo, as well as a Yeovil College Induction, to ensure that apprenticeship requirements and expectations are fully established.
The structure of the Apprenticeship programme will be as follows:
• Year 1: Part time at Yeovil College (3 days per week) to  start the Level 4 modules of the BEng Aerospace degree (knowledge/classroom based) 1 day per week. 2 days per week spent doing L2 equivalent upskilling in CAD/ AM/ Composites and Cobotics for 1 semester.
Work placements at Leonardo helicopters (1 days per week Semester 1 and 3 days Semester 2) and starting the Level 4 competence (work-related) qualification in Engineering and Advanced Manufacturing. From Feb, Start EPA portfolio compilation and complete Evidence 1 and 2
• Year 2:  Work placements at Leonardo Helicopters (4 days per week) and continuing the Level 4 competence (work-related) qualification in Engineering and Advanced Manufacturing.  Attend Yeovil College (1 day per week) to complete the Level 4 BEng degree units and start the Level 5 units. Continue with EPA portfolio compilation and complete Evidence 3 and 4.
• Year 3: Work placements at Leonardo Helicopters (4 days per week) and continuing the Level 4 competence (work-related) qualification in Engineering and Advanced Manufacturing.  Attend Yeovil College (1 day per week) to complete the Level 5 BEng degree units. Continue with EPA portfolio compilation and complete Evidence 5 and 6.
• Year 4:  Work placements at Leonardo Helicopters (4 days per week) and finish the Level 4 competence (work-related) qualification in Engineering and Advanced Manufacturing.  Attend Yeovil College (1 day per week) to start the Level 6 BEng degree units. Continue with EPA portfolio compilation and complete Evidence 7 and 8.  Achieve EPA Gateway at the end of the academic year.
• Year 5:  Work placements at Leonardo Helicopters (4 days per week) and attend Yeovil College (1 day per week) completing the Level 6 BEng and EPA Honours project.  Submit EPA portfolio and undertake EPA professional discussion. Each Apprentice on this route will need to complete an End Point Assessment as defined in the Apprenticeship Standard, this will take place in the final months of the program.
Whilst on your journey through Customer Support you will experience first-hand what it entails to support aircraft for our large customer base.
